actualGap.finding: The page gives a generic `docs:inventory:config` route, but does not tell maintainers how to regenerate and check the now-canonical bounded configuration-family reference, its required committed snapshot, or the schema-authority reference route.
actualGap.impact: A maintainer can unnecessarily enter the unrelated default global configuration/API path, or omit the inverse-reference, immutable-revision, and schema-authority outputs needed to maintain supported defaults and consumers.

sourceVerifiedCommands.purpose: Selected configuration-family facts and inverse consumers
sourceVerifiedCommands.limits: Uses the selected YAML/schema/runtime composition and retains all ordinary YAML, receiver, environment, Secret, and authority guards. It deliberately excludes executable program-output API discovery; this is not a default global configuration/API success.

sourceVerifiedCommands.order: Commit the reviewed source, family map, and generated configuration-family inventory first. The supplied full commit must contain byte-identical copies of the five hub-bound inputs.
sourceVerifiedCommands.limits: The route does not update the shared source lock and grants no SDK, runtime, deployment, or global API authority.

sourceVerifiedCommands.purpose: Schema authority, nested fields, and default/consumer dispositions
sourceVerifiedCommands.limits: Changed schema, registration, source, package, authority, or reader/default disposition stops the route. The index is not a runtime validator and schema defaults do not establish runtime default insertion.

requiredMaintainerProcedure: Review the changed source and actual consumer before editing a family map, binding, or generated fact; distinguish schema declaration/default from consumer fallback and effective value.
Use the configuration-reference route for supported family/default/consumer/inverse changes; inspect all four generated outputs and stop on any selected YAML/schema/runtime blocker.
Commit the reviewed source-plus-inventory snapshot before generating the configuration hub, then run the same bounded route in check mode.
For schema authority or nested default changes, update the existing binding only after source review and run the schema reference generation/check route.

Do not substitute `npm run docs:inventory:config` or its default global API path for this bounded route, and do not treat either bounded route as runtime, browser, provider, deployment, or live-reload evidence.
